book.name: Mateo
book.title: To Madojow no Nawnangonon no Sinuyat ni Mateo

content: To Pagdaya ki Jesus diya ki Pilato
Saju pad to masem, mighihimun on isab tibo sikan yabow no mgo magdudumaya to tinuuhan to mgo Hibru dow to inila no mgo duma dan aw planu dow og-amonuhon dan to pagpahimatoy ki Jesus.
Dajun dan gapusa si Jesus aw daeha diya ki Gubernadur Pilato.
To Pag-ogot ni Judas

Na, si Judas no migyuib ki Jesus, pagkamaan din no pighukuman on si Jesus to kamatajon, migbasul sikandin. Dajun din i-uli sikan katluan no buuk no saepi duon to sikan yabow no mgo magdudumaya to tinuuhan to mgo Hibru dow inila no mgo duma dan.
Kagi din, “Nakasae a yagboy su imbaligja ku to otow no wada sae.” Mig-iling sikandan, “Wadad yabot noy to sikan. Ikow on sikan no prublima.”
Dajun itimbag ni Judas sikan saepi duon to Bayoy to Diyus dow panow aw hikoti to liog din aw patibitoy.

Pagpuduta to sikan yabow no mgo magdudumaya to sikan saepi, mig-iling sikandan, “Ogpakayapas ki to balaod to tinuuhan ta ko isakot seini duon to saepi no kaning Diyus, su insuhue seini to pagpahimatoy to otow.”
Kaling pig-uujunan dan no igboli sikan no saepi to pasak to maghinangay to kudon su oghinangon no yobonganan to mgo yampot.
Hangtod kuntoon pighingadanan sikan to, “Pasak no Pigbajadan to Yangosa.”

Duon to sikan, natuman to diya sinuyat ni Jeremias no kibali ba-ba to Diyus no pig-iling, “Ogpuduton dan sikan katluan no buuk no saepi no iyan ogkaujunan to mgo kaliwat ni Israel no igsuhue to sikan ogyuib kandin
aw igboli dan to pasak to maghinangay to kudon. Sikan to insugu to Diyus kanay.”
Si Jesus duon to Atubangan ni Pilato
Na, pag-atubang ni Jesus ki Gubernadur Pilato, pig-usip sikandin, “Sikuna iyan to hari to mgo Hibru?” Kagi ni Jesus, “Naikagi nud.”
Di no iriklamu si Jesus to sikan yabow no mgo magdudumaya to tinuuhan to mgo Hibru dow inila no mgo duma dan, wada sikandin tabak.
Kaling mig-ikagi si Pilato, “Mahan-in to inriklamu dan kuntra ikow. Kona ka ogpanagang?”
Di wada yagboy inggad songo riklamu no pigtabak ni Jesus, kaling natingaya yagboy sikan gubernadur.
Na, kada Pista to Pagyaboy, nabatasan to sikan gubernadur no ogpasabukan din to songo prisu no iyan ogpilion to kaotawan.
To diya no panahon meyduon bantugan no prisu no iyan ngadan si Barabas.
Kaling nangusip si Pilato to sikan mahan-in no mgo otow no nahimun, “Hintawa man to ogkaliyagan now no ogpasabukan ku, si Barabas ko si Jesus no og-ilingon to Insaad no Manyuyuwas?”
Ing-usip din sikan su namaanan din no indata kandin si Jesus to mgo panguyu to tinuuhan su migsilag sikandan ki Jesus.

No mig-ingkud pad si Pilato duon to husajan, mig-abut to tugun to asawa din no pig-iling, “Kona ka ogpangindaehig to kamatajon to sikan otow no wada sae, su natagainop ku sikandin ganina madukilom, aw yagboy nasamuk to ginhawa ku.”
Na, to kaotawan pighonghongan to diya yabow no mgo magdudumaya to tinuuhan dow inila no mgo Hibru agun si Barabas to sabukan, aw si Jesus himatajan.
Kaling pag-usip on isab ni Pilato dow hintawa to sikan daduwa to ogpasabukan dan, iyan intabak dan, “Si Barabas!”
Kagi ni Pilato, “Og-amonuhon kud man naan si Jesus no og-ilingon to Insaad no Manyuyuwas?” Tibo sikandan mig-iling, “Himataji! Iyansang duon to krus!”
Mig-usip si Pilato, “Manya man? Nokoy man to sae din?” Di nasi mig-agbot to pagkinuliya dan no mig-iling, “Himataji! Iyansang duon to krus!”

Nasabut ni Pilato no wadad pues to pag-ikagi din su ogkagubut on to mgo otow. Kaling migpudut sikandin to wohig aw panghugas to boyad din duon to atubangan to mgo otow. Kagi din, “Ogpanghugas a pagpakiyaya no wada yabot ku to kamatajon to seini no otow. Sikiyu to yabotan to sikan.”
Migtabak sikan tibo mgo otow, “Sikami dow mgo kaliwat noy to tadtadan to sikan!”
Dajun pasabuki ni Pilato si Barabas. Di si Jesus pigpanyapdosan aw idata duon to sikan ogpamanyansang kandin duon to krus.
To Paghinang ki Jesus no Kangisihanan
Dajun daeha si Jesus to mgo sundayu ni Gubernadur Pilato duon to sed to bayoy din. Dajun dan himuna to tibo angod dan no mgo sundayu aw lilibongi si Jesus.
Pighukasan dan sikandin aw sul-ubi to mayogdog no kapa.

Mighinang isab sikandan to kuruna no dugihon no gawod aw ikuruna kandin. Meyduon isab tinampod no tigbow no pigpatagonan kandin duon to kalintuu no boyad din no kunungkun bastun to hari. Dajun sikandan yuhud-yuhud duon to atubangan din aw ngingisi. Kagi dan, “Mabuhi ka, hari to mgo Hibru!”
Tapus to sikan, pigpang-iloban dan si Jesus aw pinokpoka to sikan bastun din.
Pagtakahi dan to pag-inusiba
ki Jesus, pighukasan dan sikandin to sikan mayogdog no kapa aw sul-ubi to kandin no kabo. Dajun dan daeha diya to yuwas su igyansang duon to krus.
To Pagyansang ki Jesus duon to Krus
Na, duon to pangindaenan meyduon ingkatagbu dan no taga-Cirene no iyan ngadan si Simon. Pigpogos dan sikandin to pagtiang to sikan krus no ogyansangan ki Jesus.
Pagtidow dan duon to sikan banwa no og-ilingon to Golgota, no ko ita pa, Boboungon,
pigbogajan dan si Jesus to inomon no pigsakotan to mapoit. Di pagkatimtim din, wada din inoma.
Dajun dan iyansang duon to krus aw lindoga. Tapus to sikan, pigbabahin dan to mgo kabo ni Jesus pinaagi to ripa.
Dajun ingkud sikan mgo sundayu su ogbantoy kandin.
Duon to babow to uyu ni Jesus intaud dan to sinuyat no riklamu kuntra kandin no pig-iling, “Si Jesus seini no Hari to mgo Hibru.”
Meyduon isab daduwa no ka ribeldi no inyansang to mgo krus duon to magdibayuy ni Jesus.
To mgo otow no namangyaboy duon migpajango-jango to pagsujan-sujan
kandin.
“Awu!” kagi dan. “Kagi nu oggobaon nu sikan Bayoy to Diyus aw og-isabon nu oghinangon sed to tatoyu da no aedow. Oho, ko tinood no Anak ka to Diyus, yudus ka duon!”
Angod isab to sikan to pagsujan-sujan to sikan yabow no mgo magdudumaya to tinuuhan to mgo Hibru dow mgo maistru to tinuuhan hasta to duma no inila no mgo Hibru. Kagi dan,
“Nakayuwas kun sikandin to duma, di kona din man naan ogkayuwas to kaugalingon din. Oho, hari ta man buwa sikandin no mgo kaliwat ni Israel, payudusa duon agun makatuu ki.
Kagi din Anak sikandin to Diyus dow iyan ogsaligan din. Na, ko og-oyogon sikandin to Diyus, ipayuwas sikandin!”
Angod isab to sikan to pagtamay ki Jesus to sikan mgo ribeldi no inyansang isab duon to mgo krus.
To Kamatajon ni Jesus
Anoy man no maugtu on, migdigyom to kalibutan hangtod no alas tres to kahapunon.
Na, pagkaalas tres on, migtawag si Jesus to maagbot no mig-iling, “Eli, eli, lama sabaktani?” no ko ita pa, “Diyus ku, Diyus ku, nokoy no pig-ojowan a nu?”
Di to mgo otow no migtindog duon naman-iling, “Ogpatabang sikandin ki Elias.”
Na, sobuuk kandan miglinaguy dajun aw pudut to ogpasoyopan din to suka. Dajun din ihikot duon to tumuy to tinampod no tigbow aw itadwoy diya to ba-ba ni Jesus.
Di to duma mig-iling, “Og-ahaon ta iyan dow og-andini si Elias to pagyuwas kandin.”
Nangiyak on isab si Jesus aw dajun kabigtawi.

Dajun kahigbit sikan madamey no panapton no yopon to sikan Pinakabalaan no Sinabong duon to Bayoy to Diyus likat diya to diatas pailing duon to obos. Migtiyog isab to maagbot aw nangkatibag to mgo gatung.
Nangkaabri isab to mgo yobong, aw mahan-in to patoy no diyusnon no nabanhaw
aw pamanyogwa duon to yobong. Na, pagkabanhaw on ni Jesus, sikan duma no nabanhaw naman-andiya to siyudad to Jerusalem, aw mahan-in to migkita kandan.
Na, sikan kapitan dow mgo sundayu din no namanbantoy ki Jesus pigdaitan tongod to tiyog dow sikan duma no mgo hitabu. Kaling nakaikagi sikandan, “Tinood naan no Anak seini to Diyus!”
Mahan-in isab to mgo bohi no migsayap ki Jesus, di migpadiyu da. Sikandan to diya migduma-duma kandin likat to Galilea pailing diya to Jerusalem to pag-alagad kandin.
Yakip duon si Maria Magdalena dow to sangay din no inoy ni Santiago dow ni Jose hasta to asawa ni Sebedeo.
To Pagyobong ki Jesus
Anoy man no mahapun on, meyduon migtidow no sapian no otow no taga-Arimatea no iyan ngadan si Jose. Songo inanad isab sikandin ni Jesus.
Mig-andiya si Jose ki Pilato aw hangyu no sikandin to ogyobong ki Jesus. Na, mig-ujun si Pilato.
Dajun puduta ni Jose sikan yawa ni Jesus aw libodi to bag-u no madojow no panapton
aw ibotang duon to yobonganan no bag-u din pad ipabangbang duon to batu. Pigyoponan din sikan yobong to piglipid no gatung aw dajun panow.
Si Maria Magdalena dow sikan sangay din naman-ingkud no mig-atubang to sikan yobong.
To Pagbantoy to Yobong
Pagkabukas no iyan Aedow no Tigpahuway to mgo Hibru, sikan yabow no mgo magdudumaya to tinuuhan dan dow mgo Pariseo mig-andiya ki Pilato.
Kagi dan, “Sir, nadomdoman noy no wada pad kamatoy to diya gayuon no otow, mig-iling no ogkabanhaw da sikandin duon to ikatoyu no aedow.

Kaling madojow ko ipadigon nu sikan yobong din kotob to ikatoyu no aedow, su unu ko kawaton to yawa din to sikan mgo inanad din agun igkanawnangon dan no nabanhaw on sikandin. Na, ogdugang pad to paglimbung dan to kaotawan.”
“Na hala,” kagi ni Pilato. “Daya kow to mgo sundayu aw ipadigon sikan yobong kotob to ogkahimu now.”
Dajun sikandan andiya aw indani sikan inyopon agun matagahan dan ko meyduon oghilabot to sikan. Pagkatapus, pigpabantajan dan.
